params.null_stability: within-1-group (per-CpG within-column non-NaN permute → recompute BERNOULLI)
params.stability_pass: jac_real_mean > null_p95 AND excess>=0.10 AND jac_real_mean>=0.6 (Hennig)
params.align_pass: CramerV>=0.3 AND shuffle_p<0.05 AND Cochran_e>=5 (e>=5 = 可靠性閘)
params.verdict_rule: GOOD_CUT 需同一 k 同時過 stab+align(coherent); headline_k=coherent 中 max-excess(無則整體 max-excess)
